items.headline: Internal probe into CEO Jensen Huang weighs on Nvidia shares
items.summary: Nvidia shares fell as the company investigated CEO Jensen Huang; the pressure came amid broader concerns that AI-related stock valuations had become excessive.

items.headline: US stocks rally while Nvidia declines
items.summary: Major US indexes rebounded, while Nvidia declined amid leadership-related concerns and continuing debate over whether AI stocks had entered bubble territory.

items.headline: Technology shares rebound as investors reassess AI risks
items.summary: Axios reported that investors were reassessing the outlook for AI infrastructure and technology shares after an election-driven selloff, with upcoming inflation data viewed as an additional market catalyst.

items.headline: Schwab investors viewed some technology-stock selloffs as buying opportunities
items.summary: Schwab’s investor commentary indicated that some retail investors treated selloffs in technology names such as Intel as potentially overdone after disappointing results or outlooks.

items.headline: Nvidia leadership crisis becomes a test for the AI trade
items.summary: Axios described the situation surrounding Huang as a major test for Nvidia and investor confidence in the wider AI trade, given Huang’s influence over the sector.

items.headline: AI-linked stocks rebound as US indexes recover
items.summary: US equity futures rose as investors looked for value after a sharp technology and AI-stock selloff; Nvidia, AMD and other semiconductor names were in focus.
